author: reek
body: Payment processor abstraction. Defines a processor interface and provides implementations for test mode and a generic credit card gateway. Real processors (Stripe, Square, PayPal) plug in by implementing authorize/capture/refund.

author: reek
body: A processor handles three operations: 1. authorize -- reserve funds on the card, returns a processor ref 2. capture -- settle a previously authorized charge 3. refund -- return funds for a captured charge
